combat._note: Damage formula per Technical Design Doc section 3.2. Multipliers apply in this order: base-by-length -> difficulty -> first-attempt -> time -> vocabulary category -> tome -> enemy weakness/resistance.

timer._note: Base seconds per clue difficulty, per Technical Design Doc section 3.2 TimerSystem._calculate_max_time.

chains._note: Chain effect tiers per Design Doc section 4.3. A chain is a run of solved letters that spells a dictionary word.

tiers.description: Ultimate - clear an entire row or column of unsolved letters
Double rewards on the next encounter
Reveal one random unsolved letter on the grid

ink_economy._note_run_end: Milestone 3. At the end of a run: (letters + chains + category bonuses) + run_completion_bonus (completed runs only), times the equipped tomes' ink_multiplier, times defeat_retention if the run was lost. Design Doc 5.1 says 10 Ink Drops per letter; ink_per_letter stays at the Milestone 1 value of 2 until the economy is playtested - it is the one number to change.

floors._note: Milestone 4 multi-floor runs. After clearing a floor the player descends (depth + 1, a new grid, HP carried over plus descent_heal_fraction of max HP) or cashes out and banks the run. Enemy stats scale with depth (difficulty_scaling) and special abilities unlock at each enemy's unlock_depth.

boss_encounter._note: The Thesaurus guards the exit of every every_n_floors-th floor, but only for a player who has the require_unlock level unlock (Design Doc 5.2: Lv 30). Set require_unlock to "" to make the boss appear for everyone. A fight is a series of single-clue rounds against one shared HP pool; max_rounds is a backstop so a fight always ends.

progression._note: Design Doc 5.2. Total Ink Drops ever collected (spending does not lower it) needed for level L is round(base_ink * (L-1)^exponent); level 1 needs 0. level_unlocks are checked by id via PlayerLevel.is_unlocked; only the grid_7x7 / grid_9x9 unlocks gate gameplay so far, the rest are listed in the Lexicon but not yet enforced anywhere (see README).

level_unlocks.name: Chain Stacking
level_unlocks.description: Hold two active chains at once.

level_unlocks.name: Hardcore Mode
level_unlocks.description: One retry, a 15s clock, and permadeath.

level_unlocks.name: Daily Challenge
level_unlocks.description: Compete on the shared daily seed.

difficulty_scaling._note: Design Doc 4.4: base HP = 20 + (depth * 5) + (grid_size * 2); base damage = 5 + (depth * 2). hp_per_grid_size covers the grid-size term the per-enemy scaling block does not.
